The four M7 modules compiled here import nothing outside `lib/` and nothing with I/O: `lib/event-contract.ts` and `lib/event-ingest.ts` import each other and nothing else, `lib/audit.ts` and `lib/event-outbox.ts` add only `lib/sha256.ts` and `lib/ingest/hash.ts`. That is what makes M7-1's seq-ordering rule, M7-2's quarantine routing, M7-3's retry-stable id and M7-4's tamper detection provable with no Supabase project in reach (U.3, the determinism boundary).
